There have been 64 prior macro-attempts in this family and 547 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0166/micro-0006 at 1,590 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0166/micro-0007 (FF-output pair 13/188 discarded at 98.98%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 180 and 59, values -0.0278803911 and -0.0276771858 (difference 2.032e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,589 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 2.078e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map.
